name: dogfood-nextjs-rsc-streaming-app
description: Dogfood app v1.34-2 — a Next.js 15.4 + React 19.1 App Router app that drives RSC render + Suspense + streaming HTML chunks + selective hydration + view transitions across a provider-neutral surface backed by @kiwa-lab/component v0.3 semantics, runnable in both KIWA_MODE=real (Playwright + Chromium headless when RSC_STREAMING_BROWSER_READY=1) and KIWA_MODE=mock (in-memory session harness) so behavioural fidelity feeds @kiwa-lab/quality-metrics.

scripts.test: pnpm -F @kiwa-lab/component -F @kiwa-lab/core -F @kiwa-lab/nextjs -F @kiwa-lab/quality-metrics build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
